sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫简·多伊。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于查出了她的名字叫艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Spring of 2016, Detective Sergeant Randy McAllister was sitting in his office at the Cottage Grove Police Department, where he had worked for nearly 20 years.
sentences.zh: 2016年春天，侦探中士兰迪·麦卡利斯特正坐在科蒂奇格罗夫警察局的办公室里，他在那里工作了近20年。

sentences.en: If you're going to be a police officer, you could do worse than being stationed at Cottage Grove, Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 如果你打算当一名警察，驻守在明尼苏达州的科蒂奇格罗夫是个不错的选择。

sentences.en: Cottage Grove, population 36,000, lies on the north bank of the Mississippi River, a half-hour drive from the Minneapolis city centre.
sentences.zh: 科蒂奇格罗夫人口3.6万，位于密西西比河北岸，距离明尼阿波利斯市中心有半小时的车程。

sentences.en: It has its share of problems, just like any other suburb of a major metropolitan area, but nothing like the problems of the inner city.
sentences.zh: 和任何一个大型大都市的郊区一样，这里也有它的问题，但绝不像市中心那样问题重重。

sentences.en: Randy McAllister liked the quiet and predictability of working for a low-crime, small-city community.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·麦卡利斯特喜欢在犯罪率低的小城市社区工作的那份平静与可预测性。

sentences.en: Serious violent crime was rare, and over his entire career, McAllister had known of just two murders, both of which had been in the previous four years.
sentences.zh: 严重的暴力犯罪在这里极为罕见，在他的整个职业生涯中，麦卡利斯特只知道发生过两起谋杀案，而且都发生在过去四年里。

sentences.en: The 31st of May 2016 was much like any other day, until the monotony was broken up by a visit from the FBI.
sentences.zh: 2016年5月31日本该和往常一样，直到联邦调查局的造访打破了这份单调。

sentences.en: Although not an everyday occurrence,
sentences.zh: 虽然并非每天都会发生，

sentences.en: it was not completely out of the ordinary for the FBI to contact local police as a courtesy to let them know that they were investigating a crime in their area.
sentences.zh: 但联邦调查局联系当地警方，只是出于礼貌通知他们正在当地调查案件，这并不算完全反常。

sentences.en: Special Agent Asher Silkey informed Detective Sergeant McAllister that the FBI had intercepted a threat made on the internet, involving a possible victim in Cottage Grove.
sentences.zh: 特工阿瑟·西尔基向侦探中士麦卡利斯特通报称，联邦调查局截获了一条在互联网上发布的威胁信息，涉及科蒂奇格罗夫的一名潜在受害者。

sentences.en: Silkey asked if a local police officer could accompany him to notify the potential victim.
sentences.zh: 西尔基询问是否能由当地警员陪同他去通知这位潜在受害者。

sentences.en: Threat reports are a common issue.
sentences.zh: 威胁举报是一个常见的问题。

sentences.en: They usually come via the internet or text messaging.
sentences.zh: 它们通常通过互联网或手机短信发送。

sentences.en: But this one was a little different.
sentences.zh: 但这次有点不同。

sentences.en: It had come via something called the dark web.
sentences.zh: 它是通过所谓的暗网发出的。

sentences.en: It was a term that Randy McAllister had heard, but like most people, didn't really have much understanding of.
sentences.zh: 这个词兰迪·麦卡利斯特听说过，但和大多数人一样，并没有真正深入了解。

sentences.en: He assigned one of his detectives to accompany the FBI agent to visit a Mrs. Amy Allwine at her home on 7624 110th Street South, Cottage Grove.
sentences.zh: 他指派了一名侦探陪同联邦调查局特工，前往科蒂奇格罗夫南110街7624号拜访艾米·奥尔温太太。

sentences.en: 110th Street is a long, semi-rural road of very large blocks.
sentences.zh: 110街是一条漫长的半乡村道路，沿途有着很大的街区。

sentences.en: The Allwines lived in the last house on the right, before a tiny car park led to the grey cloud dunes, sand gravel prairie.
sentences.zh: 奥尔温一家住在右边的最后一栋房子，再过去是一个小型停车场，通往灰色云海沙丘和沙砾大草原。

sentences.en: The prairie was popular with walkers, and often sunset watchers would sit in parked cars, enjoying the view.
sentences.zh: 这片大草原很受散步者的欢迎，日落时分也常有观景的人把车停在路边欣赏风景。

sentences.en: The letterboxes along the street were peppered with neighbourhood watch stickers, but there were rarely any incidents that required reporting.
sentences.zh: 沿街的邮箱上贴满了邻里守望相助的贴纸，但很少发生需要报警的事件。

sentences.en: The house owned by Stephen and Amy Allwine was no shack, but the simple dwelling could not compete with the significantly larger and more elaborate homes of their neighbours.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和艾米·奥尔温夫妇的房子算不上简陋小屋，但这栋朴素的住宅根本无法与邻居们那些更大、更精致的豪宅相比。

sentences.en: It was the epitome of the worst house on the best street.
sentences.zh: 这就是“好街上最差的房子”的缩写。

sentences.en: A prefab home that had been shipped in pieces and assembled on the property.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋预制房屋，运来组件后在原地组装而成。

sentences.en: It comprised four small bedrooms, an open-plan kitchen living area, and three bathrooMs.
sentences.zh: 它包含四间小卧室、一个开放式厨房起居区以及三间浴室。

sentences.en: An attached double garage provided an alternative entry to the house, via a mudroom that doubled as a laundry.
sentences.zh: 连体的双车库提供了一条通往房子的备用入口，穿过一间兼作洗衣房的杂物间。

sentences.en: The 28 acres also held a large barn that had been refurbished to house Amy Allwine's dog training business, Active Dog Sports.
sentences.zh: 这片28英亩的土地上还有一个大谷仓，经过翻新后用作艾米·奥尔温的狗狗训练业务“活力狗狗运动”的场所。

sentences.en: The rest of the land was rented out for truck gardening.
sentences.zh: 其余的土地则出租用于卡车农业。

sentences.en: When Special Agent Silky and the local detective knocked on the door of number 7624, it was answered by a thin blonde man in his early 40s.
sentences.zh: 当西尔基特工和当地侦探敲响7624号的大门时，开门的是一位40岁出头的瘦高金发男子。

sentences.en: He was Stephen Allwine, he explained, and his wife Amy wasn't home.
sentences.zh: 他解释说自己叫斯蒂芬·奥尔温，他的妻子艾米不在家。

sentences.en: The two law enforcement officers told him they needed to speak to Amy urgently, though they didn't think she was in immediate danger.
sentences.zh: 两名执法人员告诉他，他们需要紧急找艾米谈谈，不过他们认为她没有面临直接危险。

sentences.en: They made arrangements for Amy to attend the Cottage Grove Police Department as soon as she could.
sentences.zh: 他们安排艾米尽快前往科蒂奇格罗夫警察局。

sentences.en: Stephen and Amy attended the station the next day, June 1st, 2016.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和艾米于第二天（2016年6月1日）来到了警局。

sentences.en: When the FBI agent told them why they had been called in.
sentences.zh: 当时联邦调查局特工向他们说明了被传唤的原因。

sentences.en: The story that unfolded was unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 随之浮出水面的故事简直令人难以置信。

sentences.en: The dark web is a sort of parallel internet that can only be accessed by downloading special software.
sentences.zh: 暗网是一种类似于平行的互联网，只有通过下载专门的软件才能访问。

sentences.en: Once it's installed on a computer, a user can visit websites that can't be found on the regular internet.
sentences.zh: 一旦安装在电脑上，用户就可以访问在常规互联网上找不到的网站。

sentences.en: Sites on the dark web include black markets selling weapons, drugs, forgeries, banking details, stolen goods, credit cards, and new identities.
sentences.zh: 暗网上的网站包括出售武器、毒品、赝品、银行资料、失窃物品、信用卡和新身份的黑市。

sentences.en: Illegal porn forums and file-sharing sites.
sentences.zh: 非法色情论坛和文件共享网站。

sentences.en: Political dissent and hate sites.
sentences.zh: 政治异见和仇恨网站。

sentences.en: And hacking communities.
sentences.zh: 以及黑客社区。

sentences.en: Many people refer to the dark web as the wild west of the internet, where anything goes.
sentences.zh: 许多人将暗网称为互联网的狂野西部，在那里百无禁忌。

sentences.en: It's the internet's evil twin, where people have total freedom to buy, sell, share, or create anything they want, confident that they cannot be found.
sentences.zh: 它是互联网邪恶的双胞胎，人们在那里拥有完全的自由去购买、出售、分享或创造他们想要的任何东西，并坚信自己不会被找到。

sentences.en: Some people want to buy murderous substances and implements.
sentences.zh: 有些人想要购买致命的物质和工具。

sentences.en: Some want to sell people.
sentences.zh: 有些人想要买卖人口。

sentences.en: Others want to share live streams of torture or create pictures and films of such depravity that seasoned cops who view them need counselling.
sentences.zh: 还有人想要分享虐待的直播，或是制作极其堕落的图片和电影，以至于看过它们的经验丰富的老警察都需要心理辅导。

sentences.en: And some people want to hire a hitman.
sentences.zh: 也有人想要雇凶杀人。

sentences.en: In 2016, the most popular and profitable murder-for-hire outfit on the dark web was called Bessa Mafia.
sentences.zh: 2016年，暗网上最受欢迎、最暴利的谋杀雇佣团伙名为“贝萨黑手党”。

sentences.en: Bessa Mafia opened shop on the dark web in December 2015 with a slick and professional side.
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党于2015年12月在暗网上开张，拥有一个精美且专业的网页。

sentences.en: Borrowing from the success of dark net markets like Silk Road, Bessa Mafia promised to match buyers and sellers of services.
sentences.zh: 借鉴了“丝绸之路”等暗网市场的成功经验，贝萨黑手党承诺为服务的买家和卖家牵线搭桥。

sentences.en: Someone could either sign up as a potential customer, or to offer their services as a potential killer, hacker, thug, or loan shark.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以注册成为潜在客户，或者提供自己作为潜在杀手、黑客、暴徒或高利贷者的服务。

sentences.en: When a customer posted a job, Bessa Mafia would assign a nearby operative, holding the money in escrow until the job was done to the customer's satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 当客户发布任务时，贝萨黑手党会指派一名附近的特工，并将资金托管，直到任务完成并让客户满意为止。

sentences.en: While some dark web hitman sites had tried to convey the impression they were the suave, shadowy figures of popular culture,
sentences.zh: 虽然一些暗网杀手网站试图营造出流行文化中那种圆滑、神秘人物的形象，

sentences.en: Bessa Mafia admitted outright that their hitmen were gang members and drug addicts.
sentences.zh: 但贝萨黑手党直言不讳地承认他们的杀手都是帮派成员和瘾君子。

sentences.en: Mostly stupid.
sentences.zh: 大多都很愚蠢。

sentences.en: But willing to murder a stranger, provided they were paid.
sentences.zh: 但只要给钱，他们就愿意谋杀陌生人。

sentences.en: On April 25, 2016, the Bessa Mafia website was hacked, revealing an extensive database of names, addresses, and photographs of people who had been targeted for murder.
sentences.zh: 2016年4月25日，贝萨黑手党网站遭到黑客攻击，泄露了一个庞大的数据库，里面包含了被列为谋杀目标的姓名、地址和照片。

sentences.en: At least a dozen of these names had Bitcoin addresses attached to them, meaning that the people placing the hits were serious enough that they had paid large sums of money.
sentences.zh: 其中至少有十几个名字附带了比特币地址，这意味着下单行凶的人态度认真，已经支付了巨额资金。

sentences.en: Bitcoin is a cryptocurrency, and is the favoured method of paying for illegal goods and services on the dark web.
sentences.zh: 比特币是一种加密货币，是暗网上支付非法商品和服务的首选方式。

sentences.en: Among the files was order number 30312.
sentences.zh: 在这些文件之中，有一份编号为30312的订单。

sentences.en: Target, Amy Orgwine.
sentences.zh: 目标，艾米·奥格温。

sentences.en: Description, about 5'6", looks about 200 pounds.
sentences.zh: 描述，身高约5英尺6英寸，体重约200磅。

sentences.en: The order asked that the hit be taken out when Amy would be at La Quinta Inn at Moline Airport in Illinois.
sentences.zh: 订单要求在艾米身处伊利诺伊州莫林机场的拉金塔酒店时动手。

sentences.en: She would be driving a dark green Toyota Sienna minivan.
sentences.zh: 她将驾驶一辆深绿色的丰田锡耶纳小型货车。

sentences.en: There was a link to a photograph that showed a happy Amy on a family holiday in Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 其中附有一张照片的链接，显示了艾米在夏威夷全家度假时快乐的模样。

sentences.en: The associated Bitcoin address showed that Bitcoin worth around $12,000 to $13,000 had been paid to Bessa Mafia for her murder.
sentences.zh: 关联的比特币地址显示，已向贝萨黑手党支付了价值约12,000至13,000美元的比特币作为她的杀戮费用。

sentences.en: The person ordering the hit called themselves Dog Day God.
sentences.zh: 下达暗杀订单的人自称为“狗日上帝”。

sentences.en: Dog Day God first contacted Bessa Mafia on February 15th, 2016, sending an email that said,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”于2016年2月15日首次联系贝萨黑手党，发送了一封电子邮件，上面写着：

sentences.en: I'm looking to hire you for a hit, but what is the recommended way to convert cash to Bitcoin anonymously?
sentences.zh: 我打算雇佣你们执行一次暗杀，但匿名将现金转换为比特币的推荐方法是什么？

sentences.en: Dog Day God was concerned that pulling out a large sum of money to buy Bitcoin would raise suspicion of the authorities, so they wanted advice on how to hide the transaction.
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”担心提取巨额资金购买比特币会引起当局的怀疑，因此他们想要征求如何隐藏这笔交易的建议。

sentences.en: The response from Bessa Mafia was swift and helpful.
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党的回复迅速且乐于助人。

sentences.en: The customer service administrator provided Dog Day God with the names of a couple of Bitcoin traders that didn't require identification,
sentences.zh: 客服管理员向“狗日上帝”提供了几个不需要身份验证的比特币交易员的名字，

sentences.en: and suggested there were several ways to explain away the missing money, investment, purchasing goods and services, or gambling online.
sentences.zh: 并建议有几种方法可以解释这笔凭空消失的资金，比如投资、购买商品和服务，或者在线赌博。

sentences.en: Dog Day God wrote back,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”回信道：

sentences.en: The target will be travelling out of town to Moline, Illinois, in March.
sentences.zh: 目标将于3月份前往伊利诺伊州莫林出差。

sentences.en: What is the price in Bitcoin for a hit, ideally making it look like an accident?
sentences.zh: 买凶杀人需要多少比特币，最好能伪装成意外？

sentences.en: Several emails went back and forth between Dog Day God and the administrator of the Bessa Mafia site.
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”与贝萨黑手党网站的管理员来来回回发了好几封邮件。

sentences.en: The starting point was $5,000, which would be a hit by a low-level gang member wearing a turtleneck and using a handgun.
sentences.zh: 起步价是5,000美元，将由一个穿着高领衫、使用手枪的低级帮派成员动手。

sentences.en: Staging an accident would usually cost an extra $4,000.
sentences.zh: 制造意外通常需要额外支付4,000美元。

sentences.en: They eventually settled on $6,000 for a gang member to wait at a predetermined location and ram Amy with a stolen car.
sentences.zh: 他们最终敲定以6,000美元的价格，让一名帮派成员在预定地点守候并用失车撞击艾米。

sentences.en: Dog Day God provided details of a trip Amy would be taking to a dog training event in Moline on March 19, 2016.
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”提供了艾米将于2016年3月19日前往莫林参加狗狗训练活动的行程细节。

sentences.en: The Bessa Mafia admin agreed to take the job and told Dog Day God,
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党管理员同意接单，并告诉“狗日上帝”：

sentences.en: On March 19, make sure you are surrounded by people most of the day or in public places where they have video surveillance.
sentences.zh: 在3月19日那天，确保你整天大部分时间都被人群包围，或者呆在有视频监控的公共场所。

sentences.en: If you have a good alibi, they can't do anything else than say it was an accident and close the case.
sentences.zh: 如果你有好的不在场证明，他们除了说这是一场意外并结案之外，别无他法。

sentences.en: Dog Day God responded,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”回复道：

sentences.en: Thank you for the reminder.
sentences.zh: 谢谢提醒。

sentences.en: I will make sure I have a good alibi.
sentences.zh: 我会确保自己有充足的不在场证明。

sentences.en: The transaction was completed, the Bitcoin paid, and everything set for Amy Allwine to be killed in Moline, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 交易完成，比特币支付完毕，一切就绪，只等艾米·奥尔温在伊利诺伊州莫林被杀。

sentences.en: On March 20,
Dog Day God wrote to Bessa Mafia asking whether the job had been carried out.
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”给贝萨黑手党写信，询问任务是否已经执行。

sentences.en: Bessa Mafia replied,
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党回复说：

sentences.en: No, not yet.
sentences.zh: 不，还没有。

sentences.en: The hitman has followed her, but he didn't have the chance to do the hit yet.
sentences.zh: 杀手一直在跟踪她，但还没有找到动手的机会。

sentences.en: He needs to be in a position where he can hit her car to the driver door to make sure she dies.
sentences.zh: 他需要找到一个能撞击她汽车驾驶员工门的位置，以确保她必死无疑。

sentences.en: Bessa Mafia suggested a sniper might be a better option, provided nobody would suspect Dog Day God if Amy was obviously murdered.
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党建议狙击手可能是更好的选择，前提是如果艾米被明显谋杀，不会有人怀疑到“狗日上帝”头上。

sentences.en: Dog Day God responded,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”回复道：

sentences.en: No, I would not be a suspect.
sentences.zh: 不，我不会成为嫌疑人。

sentences.en: I'm fine with whatever you think is beSt.
sentences.zh: 你们觉得哪个最好，我都行。

sentences.en: Bessa Mafia assured Dog Day God that a sniper had a 100% success rate, but would cost another $6,000.
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党向“狗日上帝”保证，狙击手的成功率是100%，但需要额外支付6,000美元。

sentences.en: Dog Day God didn't have the amount handy, and the hitman was apparently unable to find an opportune time to ram Amy's car, so the hit was not carried out.
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”手头没有那么多钱，而且杀手显然找不到合适的时机去撞击艾米的汽车，因此行刺未能实施。

sentences.en: The next day, Bessa Mafia wrote,
sentences.zh: 第二天，贝萨黑手党写道：

sentences.en: We don't usually ask this because we are not interested in the reason why the people are killed, but if she is your wife or some family member, we can do it in your city as well,
sentences.zh: 我们通常不会问这些，因为我们对人们被杀的原因不感兴趣，但如果她是你的妻子或某个家庭成员，我们也可以在你们的城市动手，

sentences.en: making it look like an accident or robbery.
sentences.zh: 把它伪装成意外或抢劫。

sentences.en: Dog Day God wrote back,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”回信道：

sentences.en: Not my wife, but I was thinking the same thing.
sentences.zh: 不是我妻子，不过我也有同感。

sentences.en: How much would it be to kill her at home and then burn their house so that they could not tell if anything was stolen?
sentences.zh: 如果在她家里杀了她，然后烧掉房子，让人分不清有没有东西被偷，要花多少钱？

sentences.en: I'm not sure if they have anything worth stealing.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他们家里有没有什么值得偷的东西。

sentences.en: This Thursday, I know she will be home between about 9 and noon Central Time.
sentences.zh: 本周四，我知道她会在中部时间9点到中午之间在家。

sentences.en: Her home address is 7624,
sentences.zh: 她的家庭住址是7624号，

sentences.en: 110th Street South,
Cottage Grove, Minnesota, near Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州科蒂奇格罗夫，靠近明尼阿波利斯。

sentences.en: Bessa Mafia agreed to kill Amy at home and burn down the house, but it would cost an extra 10 Bitcoin.
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党同意在家里杀死艾米并烧毁房子，但这需要额外支付10个比特币。

sentences.en: Dog Day God deposited the extra funds the next day and emailed Bessa Mafia confirmation that the deposit had gone to a specific Bitcoin address.
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”第二天存入了额外的资金，并向贝萨黑手党发电子邮件确认存款已汇入特定的比特币地址。

sentences.en: Bitcoin addresses are a string of 34 characters and numbers.
sentences.zh: 比特币地址是一串由34个字符和数字组成的字符串。

sentences.en: Each address is unique and is proof that a transaction took place.
sentences.zh: 每个地址都是唯一的，是交易发生的证明。

sentences.en: Anyone can go online to the site blockchain.info and see exactly when and how much Bitcoin has moved into or out of an address, although there is no way of telling
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以上网访问blockchain.info网站，确切查看比特币何时以及有多少流入或流出某个地址，尽管无法知道

sentences.en: who is on either side of the transaction.
sentences.zh: 交易的任何一方究竟是谁。

sentences.en: Dog Day God wrote,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”写道：

sentences.en: Okay, I've got some more details on her schedule.
sentences.zh: 好的，我拿到了她日程安排的更多细节。

sentences.en: I'm trying to get as much as I can without being obvious.
sentences.zh: 我正尽量在不引人注目的大前提下多打听点信息。

sentences.en: It looks like she'll be home tomorrow from 12 till 1pm and Thursday from 12 till 1pm.
sentences.zh: 看来她明天中午12点到下午1点以及周四中午12点到下午1点会在家。

sentences.en: Those are the only times that I know about at the moment.
sentences.zh: 这是目前我所知道的仅有的时间段。

sentences.en: Let me know the plan so I can be somewhere else public.
sentences.zh: 把计划告诉我，这样我好去其他公众场所避开。

sentences.en: I know her husband has a big tractor, so I suspect that he has gas cans in the garage, but I do not know that for sure.
sentences.zh: 我知道她丈夫有一台大拖拉机，所以我猜他在车库里备有汽油桶，但我不敢百分之百确定。

sentences.en: She usually drives the Sienna, so if that's there, she should be home.
sentences.zh: 她通常开那辆锡耶纳，如果车在那儿，她应该就在家。

sentences.en: Thursday, March 24 came and went
sentences.zh: 3月24日星期四转瞬即逝，

sentences.en: and Amy was not killed.
sentences.zh: 而艾米并没有被杀。

sentences.en: Bessa Mafia said the hitman had problems trying to get to the location and asked if the hit could be carried out another time.
sentences.zh: 贝萨黑手党称，杀手在试图前往该地点时遇到了麻烦，并询问是否可以在另一个时间执行任务。

sentences.en: Dog Day God replied,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”回复道：

sentences.en: Yes, I do want it done, but I have to pretend to be her friend to get this information and it's driving me crazy to be nice to her.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实想除掉她，但我必须假装是她的朋友才能套出这些信息，对她假意迎合快把我逼疯了。

sentences.en: I'm also afraid that if I dig for information too many more times, that it will look strange.
sentences.zh: 我也担心如果再三打听消息，会显得很奇怪。

sentences.en: They rescheduled for the following Monday morning, but again, the hit wasn't carried out.
sentences.zh: 他们将行动重新安排在接下来的星期一早晨，但行刺依然没有实施。

sentences.en: According to Bessa Mafia, this time, the assigned hitman was stopped by police for a registration check and as he was in a stolen car, he was taken in for questioning.
sentences.zh: 据贝萨黑手党称，这一次，指派的杀手因车辆登记检查被警察拦下，由于他开的是一辆赃车，随即被带走接受盘问。

sentences.en: Dog Day God was getting frustrated and wrote,
sentences.zh: “狗日上帝”开始感到沮丧，写道：

sentences.en: I realise that things happen, but this bitch has torn my family apart by sleeping with my husband, who then left me, and is stealing clients from my business.
sentences.zh: 我知道世事难料，但这贱人通过跟我丈夫睡觉撕裂了我的家庭，我丈夫随后抛弃了我，她还在抢夺我生意的客户。

sentences.en: I have had to continue to act like her friend to get information and I cannot do it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不得不继续假装是她的朋友来获取信息，我再也受不了了。

sentences.en: I have gone out of my way to try and get you good information.
sentences.zh: 我已经尽我所能为你们提供准确的情报。

sentences.en: I feel that I am at risk of being suspected if I ask too many more questions.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果我再问更多问题，自己就会有被怀疑的风险。

sentences.en: You have had three good attempts at her and none of them have worked.
sentences.zh: 你们对她进行了三次好好的尝试，结果全都泡汤了。

sentences.en: I liked the idea of shooting and fire because I think it would look like a robbery and cover up, but I'm at the point that I do not care how it's done.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢枪击和火灾的主意，因为我觉得这看起来像是一起抢劫并能掩盖罪证，但我现在已经不管怎么做了，只要能成就行。

sentences.en: I believe that if I go about my regular routine, that I will not be a suspect.
sentences.zh: 我相信如果我照常过日子，就不会成为嫌疑人。

sentences.en: If it's not done in some way by May 1st, then I would like my money back.
sentences.zh: 如果在5月1日前还没有以某种方式完成，那么我想把钱退回来。

sentences.en: Does that sound like enough time for you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得给你们的时间够吗？

sentences.en: I cannot get my hopes built up again like I did this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我不能像这个周末这样，再次把希望寄托得那么高。

sentences.en: I don't care about date or method.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎日期或方法。

sentences.en: You have her picture and address, so you can tell her or do whatever you need to do to get the job done.
sentences.zh: 你有她的照片和地址，所以你可以告诉她，或者做任何你需要做的事情来完成任务。

sentences.en: I do know that she is going to take a trip to Atlanta the weekend of April 7 to 10, but I do not know the details.
sentences.zh: 我确实知道她打算在4月7日至10日这个周末去亚特兰大旅行，但我不知道具体细节。

sentences.en: I also was passing by recently when they had the garage door open and I was able to see that they have three five-gallon gas cans just outside the door from the house to the garage
sentences.zh: 我最近路过时，发现他们车库门开着，我看到他们从房子通往车库的门外放着三个五加仑的汽油桶

sentences.en: and what looked like a propane tank as well.
sentences.zh: 还有一个看起来像丙烷罐的东西。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if any of them are full, but they are there.
sentences.zh: 我不确定它们是不是满的，但它们就在那里。

sentences.en: Thanks for your help with this.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你在这件事上的帮助。

sentences.en: I need her out of my life so I can move on.
sentences.zh: 我需要她从我的生活中消失，这样我才能继续前进。

sentences.en: As the story unfolded in the Cottage Grove police station,
sentences.zh: 随着故事在科蒂奇格罗夫警察局展开，

sentences.en: Stephen and Amy Allwine expressed great shock.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和埃米·奥尔温表现出极大的震惊。

sentences.en: As far as Amy was aware, she had no enemies.
sentences.zh: 就埃米所知，她没有任何敌人。

sentences.en: She never even had disagreements with anyone, personal or business.
sentences.zh: 她甚至从不与任何人发生分歧，无论是私事还是公事。

sentences.en: She was a normal suburban housewife who had just three things in life she cared about.
sentences.zh: 她是一个普通的郊区家庭主妇，生活中只关心三件事。

sentences.en: Her family, her church and her dogs.
sentences.zh: 她的家庭、她的教会和她的狗。

sentences.en: She was adamant that she had never been and would never be unfaithful to her husband.
sentences.zh: 她坚决表示，她过去从未、将来也绝不会对丈夫不忠。

sentences.en: Their marriage was rock solid and that would go against everything she believed in.
sentences.zh: 他们的婚姻坚如磐石，这违背了她所信仰的一切。

sentences.en: Amy Allwine grew up dedicating herself to her faith and to helping others.
sentences.zh: 埃米·奥尔温从小就致力于自己的信仰和帮助他人。

sentences.en: Born to a couple who were adherents to a fundamentalist religion, which later became known as the United Church of God,
sentences.zh: 她的父母是某个原教旨主义宗教的信徒，该宗教后来被称为联合基督教会，

sentences.en: Amy was the middle child with an older sister and younger brother.
sentences.zh: 埃米是中间的孩子，有一个姐姐和一个弟弟。

sentences.en: The children were not allowed to take part in extracurricular activities at school, nor did they have any friends from outside the church.
sentences.zh: 孩子们不允许参加学校的课外活动，也没有任何来自教会外部的朋友。

sentences.en: Amy attended Woodbury High School, where her participation in school life was limited to lessons.
sentences.zh: 埃米就读于伍德伯里高中，她在学校生活的参与局限于课堂学习。

sentences.en: Nevertheless,
sentences.zh: 然而，

sentences.en: Amy had a happy childhood and had a social life that revolved around the family's faith.
sentences.zh: 埃米拥有快乐的童年，其社交生活围绕着家庭的信仰展开。

sentences.en: She was an enthusiastic cheerleader for the church basketball team and put a lot of time into developing dance routines for the girls on the squad.
sentences.zh: 她是教会篮球队的热情拉拉队员，花了很多时间为队员们编排舞蹈。

sentences.en: Adhering to the conservative values of the church, there were no skimpy outfits or suggestive moves in Amy's choreography.
sentences.zh: 秉持教会的保守价值观，埃米的编舞中没有任何暴露的服装或暗示性的动作。

sentences.en: Stephen Allwine met Amy when they were both students at Ambassador College in Big Sandy, Texas.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·奥尔温在德克萨斯州大桑迪的大使学院读书时遇到了埃米。

sentences.en: Stephen was also from a family that worshipped at the United Church of God.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬也来自一个在联合基督教会礼拜的家庭。

sentences.en: Not so much an educational institution as a training ground to prepare youth
sentences.zh: 与其说这是一个教育机构，不如说是一个为年轻人做准备的训练场，

sentences.en: the college had a motto,
sentences.zh: 这所学院有一个座右铭，

sentences.en: recapturing true values.
sentences.zh: 找回真正的价值观。

sentences.en: Stephen and Amy got to know each other through church socials, where they would always choose each other as dance partners.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和埃米通过教会的社交活动互相了解，在那里他们总是选择对方作为舞伴。

sentences.en: After college,
sentences.zh: 大学毕业后，

sentences.en: Stephen moved to Amy's hometown of St. Paul, Minnesota, and they married on August 11, 1996, in Cottage Grove.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬搬到了埃米的家乡明尼苏达州圣保罗，他们于1996年8月11日在科蒂奇格罗夫结婚。

sentences.en: Amy's father, Charles, placed Amy's hand into Stephen's and said, take good care of my little girl.
sentences.zh: 埃米的父亲查尔斯将埃米的手交到斯蒂芬手中，并说，好好照顾我的宝贝女儿。

sentences.en: Both Stephen and Amy were deeply committed to the church.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和埃米都深深地忠于教会。

sentences.en: God and religion played a central part in their life together.
sentences.zh: 上帝和宗教在他们共同的生活中扮演着核心角色。

sentences.en: The United Church of God adheres strictly and literally to the teachings of the Bible, including those of the Old Testament.
sentences.zh: 联合基督教会严格且字面地遵循圣经的教义，包括旧约中的教义。

sentences.en: In some circles, the small religion is defined as a cult.
sentences.zh: 在某些圈子里，这个小型宗教被定义为一个邪教。

sentences.en: Members are expected to marry only within of the faith, which meant, according to one former member,
sentences.zh: 成员被期望只能在信仰内部结婚，这意味着，根据一位前成员的说法，

sentences.en: the pool was very small.
sentences.zh: 选择范围非常小。

sentences.en: Stephen and Amy did not observe
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和埃米不庆祝

sentences.en: Christmas or Easter as the United Church of God teaches that these are pagan celebrations.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节或复活节，因为联合基督教会教导说这些是异教庆典。

sentences.en: The All Wines attended services every Saturday at a modest building in St. Paul.
sentences.zh: 奥尔温一家每个星期六都会去圣保罗的一座简朴建筑参加礼拜。

sentences.en: They would arrive around 12.30, a good hour before the service began, and would stay for all the activities afterwards, not leaving until the evening.
sentences.zh: 他们通常在12点30分左右到达，也就是礼拜开始前一个小时，并会留下来参加之后的所有活动，直到傍晚才离开。

sentences.en: Stephen and Amy spent most of their spare time together, and the bulk of that time was devoted to church business.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和埃米把大部分业余时间都花在了一起，其中绝大部分时间都奉献给了教会事务。

sentences.en: They travelled extensively, serving congregations around the world and taking part in humanitarian efforts.
sentences.zh: 他们广泛旅行，为世界各地的会众服务并参与人道主义工作。

sentences.en: The two were ordained as deacon and deaconess of the United Church of God in the spring of 2006.
sentences.zh: 两人于2006年春季被按立为联合基督教会的执事和女执事。

sentences.en: After that,
sentences.zh: 此后，

sentences.en: Stephen rose to the position of elder, with responsibility for counselling married couples, giving sermons at church, and anointing those who fell ill.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬晋升为长老，负责辅导已婚夫妇、在教会讲道以及为生病的人行涂油礼。

sentences.en: A year later, they adopted their only child, a son,
sentences.zh: 一年后，他们收养了唯一的孩子，一个男孩，

sentences.en: Amy bringing him home when he was just two days old.
sentences.zh: 埃米在他只有两天大的时候把他带回家。

sentences.en: It was an open adoption, and the Allwine stayed in touch with his birth mother.
sentences.zh: 这是一场开放式收养，奥尔温夫妇与他的亲生母亲保持着联系。

sentences.en: She had chosen them because Amy was unable to have children.
sentences.zh: 她选择他们是因为埃米无法生育。

sentences.en: They were dog people, and they were a very loving and affectionate couple.
sentences.zh: 他们是爱狗人士，也是一对非常恩爱和深情的夫妻。

sentences.en: The desperately wanted child became part of the family and joined the tradition of Friday night dinners with Amy's parents and brother.
sentences.zh: 这个渴望已久的孩子成为了家庭的一部分，并延续了周五晚上与埃米的父母和弟弟共进晚餐的传统。

sentences.en: On those nights,
sentences.zh: 在那些夜晚，

sentences.en: Amy's mother would put out the good china and silverware while her father prepared the food.
sentences.zh: 埃米的母亲会摆出精美的瓷器和银器，而她的父亲则准备食物。

sentences.en: Amy always brought dessert, usually strawberry pie, which was her mother's favourite.
sentences.zh: 埃米总是带甜点，通常是她母亲最喜欢的草莓派。

sentences.en: When he was old enough, their son Joe would join Amy in picking the biggest, juiciest, fresh strawberries they could find to make the pie.
sentences.zh: 当他足够大时，他们的儿子乔会和埃米一起挑选最大、最多汁、最新鲜的草莓来做馅饼。

sentences.en: Well known and loved for her generosity,
sentences.zh: 埃米以慷慨大方而闻名并备受喜爱，

sentences.en: Amy travelled extensively doing charitable deeds and spreading the word of God
sentences.zh: 她四处旅行做慈善事业并传播上帝的话语。

sentences.en: Amy's parents, siblings, husband and later their son would travel overseas every other year for the fall religious festival of their church, the Harvest FeaSt.
sentences.zh: 埃米的父母、兄弟姐妹、丈夫以及后来的儿子每隔一年都会出国参加他们教会的秋季宗教节日，即收获节。

sentences.en: Amy's primary passion outside the church was dogs.
sentences.zh: 埃米在教会之外的主要热情是狗。

sentences.en: She had been a dog lover since childhood and as an adult, she became an active and popular member of the dog training and competition scene.
sentences.zh: 她从小就是个爱狗人士，成年后，她成为了狗训练和比赛领域的一位活跃且受欢迎的成员。

sentences.en: Before long, her Australian shepherds were frequent competition winners thanks to Amy's talent for training.
sentences.zh: 不久，由于埃米的训练天赋，她的澳大利亚牧羊犬频繁在比赛中获胜。

sentences.en: That knack with dogs saw Amy turn her hobby into a career, training other people's dogs to compete in agility trials and competitions.
sentences.zh: 这种与狗相处的天赋使埃米将爱好变成了事业，训练别人的狗参加敏捷性试验和比赛。

sentences.en: She opened her training school, active dog sports and threw herself into the business of dog training in a way that was consistent with her values.
sentences.zh: 她开设了她的训练学校“活跃犬类运动”，并以符合她价值观的方式全身心投入到狗训练事业中。

sentences.en: Although her core business was to train dogs to be competitive, she didn't put pressure on owners who wanted to keep the training just for fun.
sentences.zh: 尽管她的核心业务是训练狗去参加比赛，但她不会给只想把训练当作乐趣的主人施加压力。

sentences.en: Her clients, both dog and human, adored her.
sentences.zh: 她的客户，无论是狗还是人，都非常崇拜她。

sentences.en: The dog training shed on the Allwines property was three times the size of their house and Amy made sure it was kept immaculate.
sentences.zh: 奥尔温家房产上的训狗棚有他们房子三倍大，埃米确保它保持得一尘不染。

sentences.en: Active dog sports grew to be a respected and successful business, offering an array of dog-related services and leading the way in dog nose work.
sentences.zh: “活跃犬类运动”发展成为一项受人尊敬且成功的事业，提供一系列与狗相关的服务，并在犬类嗅觉工作方面处于领先地位。

sentences.en: Amy's sunny personality and her training by positive reinforcement saw her friendship group among fellow dog lovers grow to become second only to her church group.
sentences.zh: 埃米阳光开朗的性格以及她采用正向强化的训练方法，使她在同行爱狗人士中的朋友圈不断扩大，仅次于她的教会群体。

sentences.en: Despite her growing success,
sentences.zh: 尽管她不断取得成功，

sentences.en: Amy's first priority continued to be her family and her church.
sentences.zh: 埃米的首要任务仍然是她的家庭和教会。

sentences.en: She would never work or attend shows on Saturday, which was her Sabbath.
sentences.zh: 她从不在星期六工作或参加比赛，那是她的安息日。

sentences.en: She was known for being relentlessly positive.
sentences.zh: 她以极其乐观的态度而闻名。

sentences.en: Friends claimed she was never without a huge smile and they described her as a sweet, friendly and loving person.
sentences.zh: 朋友们声称她总是带着灿烂的笑容，并形容她是一个甜美、友好且充满爱心的人。

sentences.en: She was never negative, never judgmental and never gossipy.
sentences.zh: 她从不消极，从不评判他人，也从不传闲话。

sentences.en: Whilst being utterly devoted to her faith,
sentences.zh: 尽管对自己的信仰无比忠诚，

sentences.en: Amy wasn't evangelical to those who didn't share her beliefs.
sentences.zh: 艾米对那些不认同她信仰的人并不盲目狂热。

sentences.en: According to those who knew her in the competitive dog circles, one of her most outstanding attributes was her empathy.
sentences.zh: 据那些在竞争激烈的养狗圈子里认识她的人说，她最突出的特质之一就是同理心。

sentences.en: Part of that empathy was her ability to imagine how she would feel if someone were to impose their beliefs onto her.

sentences.en: Stephen soon posted the $500,000 bail, which had several conditions attached, including GPS monitoring and only supervised visits with his son, Joe.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬很快缴纳了50万美元保释金，保释附带了多项条件，包括GPS监控以及只能在监督下探望儿子乔。

sentences.en: Joe was to stay with his maternal grandparents and Stephen returned to the home he had shared with Amy.
sentences.zh: 乔将与外祖父母住在一起，而斯蒂芬回到了他与艾米共同居住的家中。

sentences.en: It was a matter of just two weeks before Stephen was arrested again, after Amy's parents reported to authorities that he had tried to contact his son,
sentences.zh: 仅仅两周后，斯蒂芬再次被捕，因为艾米的父母向当局报告称他试图联系儿子，

sentences.en: with whom he was supposed to have no unsupervised contact.
sentences.zh: 而他本应被禁止与儿子进行任何无人监督的接触。

sentences.en: Stephen had asked Amy's parents to charge up his son's smartwatch so that he could track his whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬曾要求艾米的父母给儿子的智能手表充电，以便他能追踪儿子的行踪。

sentences.en: The judge raised the amount required for conditional bail to $600,000 and ordered Stephen to have no contact with his son or Amy's parents.
sentences.zh: 法官将有条件保释金提高到60万美元，并下令斯蒂芬不得与儿子或艾米的父母接触。

sentences.en: He once again managed to post bail and was free to return home.
sentences.zh: 他再次设法缴纳了保释金，并获准回家。

sentences.en: On March 24, 2017, a grand jury elevated the charge against Stephen to first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 2017年3月24日，大陪审团将针对斯蒂芬的指控升级为一级谋杀。

sentences.en: The judge said his unconditional bail at $2 million and conditional bail at $1 million.
sentences.zh: 法官将其无条件保释金定为200万美元，有条件保释金定为100万美元。

sentences.en: This time, Stephen was unable to post it and he was remanded in custody to await trial.
sentences.zh: 这一次，斯蒂芬无法缴纳保释金，被还押候审。

sentences.en: On January 23, 2018, after six days of questioning 50 potential jurors, the opposing attorneys finally settled on a pool of eight women and seven men
sentences.zh: 2018年1月23日，在经过六天对50名潜在陪审员的询问后，控辩双方最终确定了由八名女性和七名男性组成的陪审团，

sentences.en: to decide whether Stephen Allwine killed his wife.
sentences.zh: 来裁定斯蒂芬·奥尔怀恩是否杀害了他的妻子。

sentences.en: Three of them were spares.
sentences.zh: 其中三人是候补陪审员。

sentences.en: Those who were chosen professed a working knowledge of computers, but no in-depth technical expertise.
sentences.zh: 入选者都声称具备计算机应用知识，但没有深入的技术专长。

sentences.en: In his final case before retirement,
sentences.zh: 在他退休前的最后一个案件中，

sentences.en: District Judge B.
sentences.zh: 地区法官B·威廉·埃克斯特罗姆主持了

sentences.en: William Ekstrom presided over the most bizarre trial
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州华盛顿县有史以来最离奇的审判。

sentences.en: Washington County, Minnesota had ever seen.
sentences.zh: （接上文）华盛顿县有史以来最离奇的审判。

sentences.en: Over the next week, prosecutors drew together the threads of evidence that pointed to Stephen Allwine being Bessa Mafia customer Dog Day God
sentences.zh: 在接下来的一周里，检察官梳理了证据线索，指出斯蒂芬·奥尔怀恩就是“Bessa Mafia”的客户“Dog Day”，

sentences.en: and to the man who ultimately pulled the trigger that took Amy Allwine's life.
sentences.zh: 也是最终扣动扳机夺走艾米·奥尔怀恩生命的那个人。

sentences.en: The prosecution claimed Stephen Allwine gave Amy the scopolamine in her lunch, then got his son Joe out of the house before shooting Amy while she was disorientated from the drug.
sentences.zh: 检方声称，斯蒂芬·奥尔温在午餐时给艾米服下了东莨菪碱，随后将儿子乔支开，趁艾米因药物作用神志不清时将其枪杀。

sentences.en: He then cleaned up the blood and burned the cleaning cloth and any clothes that had been spattered.
sentences.zh: 接着，他清理了血迹，并烧毁了清洁用的抹布以及任何溅上血迹的衣物。

sentences.en: Later, he went to collect his son, carefully keeping receipts from the places he visited as an alibi.
sentences.zh: 随后，他去接儿子，并特意保留了所到之处的收据，以此作为不在场证明。

sentences.en: When he returned home, he let his son go in ahead of him to find his mother on the floor of the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，他让儿子先走进屋，去发现倒在卧室地板上的母亲。

sentences.en: Stephen Allwine's motive for killing his wife was simply that he wanted out of their marriage.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·奥尔温杀妻的动机很简单，他只是想结束这段婚姻。

sentences.en: However, nothing was more important to him than his status in the United Church of God.
sentences.zh: 然而，对他而言，没有什么比他在上帝联合教会的地位更重要了。

sentences.en: He would lose his role if he were to initiate divorce proceedings.
sentences.zh: 如果他主动提出离婚，就会失去自己的职位。

sentences.en: In fact, the church would probably ask him to leave the congregation altogether.
sentences.zh: 事实上，教会很可能会要求他彻底离开会众。

sentences.en: Throughout the trial, the courtroom was filled to capacity with family from both sides, church congregation members and to the professional dog training community.
sentences.zh: 庭审期间，法庭内座无虚席，坐满了双方的家人、教会成员以及专业训犬界的人士。

sentences.en: They took their own notes, which they would compare during breaks and probe for inconsistencies in testimony.
sentences.zh: 他们各自做着笔记，在休庭时进行比对，并探究证词中是否存在矛盾之处。

sentences.en: Stephen and Amy's pastor would spend breaks cancelling family and friends who were trying to make sense of what had happened.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和艾米的牧师在休庭时忙于安抚那些试图弄清真相的亲友。

sentences.en: Stephen showed almost no emotion throughout the trial.
sentences.zh: 在整个庭审过程中，斯蒂芬几乎没有表现出任何情绪。

sentences.en: He did not turn to look at his family and rarely acknowledged his own lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他没有回头看家人，也极少与自己的律师交流。

sentences.en: Instead, he would read through every report and piece of evidence that was tendered and occasionally pour himself a paper cup of water.
sentences.zh: 相反，他会仔细阅读每一份提交的报告和证据，偶尔给自己倒上一杯水。

sentences.en: Sometimes, when it seemed appropriate, such as when the 911 call was played and photographs of Amy's body were displayed, he would appear to be sobbing.
sentences.zh: 有时，在某些看似合适的时刻，比如播放911报警电话录音或展示艾米遗体照片时，他看起来像是在啜泣。

sentences.en: However, the box of tissues in front of him remained untouched.
sentences.zh: 然而，他面前的那盒纸巾却始终未被动过。

sentences.en: The trial called for a wide array of witnesses, including an escort, a Bitcoin trader, a pawnbroker, neighbours, dog trainers, an array of forensic and medical specialists,
sentences.zh: 庭审传唤了大量的证人，包括一名伴游、一名比特币交易员、一名典当商、邻居、训犬师，以及一系列法医和医学专家，

sentences.en: as well as the law enforcement officers who had attended the incident and worked the case.
sentences.zh: 还有处理过该事件并负责此案的执法人员。

sentences.en: The prosecution elicited responses from witnesses that cumulatively built an airtight case against the defendant.
sentences.zh: 检方从证人那里获取的证词，共同构建了一个针对被告的铁证如山的案件。

sentences.en: The Bitcoin trader confirmed that he had met Stephen at a fast food restaurant to sell him Bitcoin, and Stephen's presence there was confirmed by a call-out to roadside assistance
sentences.zh: 比特币交易员证实，他曾在一家快餐店与斯蒂芬见面并向其出售比特币，而斯蒂芬当时出现在那里的事实，通过他因将钥匙锁在车内而拨打的道路救援电话得到了证实。

sentences.en: when he locked his keys in his car.
sentences.zh: 当时他把钥匙锁在了车里。

sentences.en: The escort confirmed she had met the man of God through Backpage.com and they had sex together for $400 for an overnight stay,
sentences.zh: 那名伴游证实，她是通过Backpage.com网站认识这位“上帝的仆人”的，他们曾以400美元的价格进行过一夜情交易，

sentences.en: long before his Ashley Madison flings.
sentences.zh: 这远在他与阿什莉·麦迪逊网站上的那些风流韵事之前。

sentences.en: The bloody footprints at the scene of the crime matched Stephen Orwine's socked feet.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场的血脚印与斯蒂芬·奥尔温穿着袜子的脚相吻合。

sentences.en: The gunshot residue test was positive on his right hand.
sentences.zh: 他的右手枪击残留物检测结果呈阳性。

sentences.en: The furnace had been going that afternoon, despite it being unseasonably warm, which suggested Stephen had burned evidence.
sentences.zh: 尽管那天下午天气异常温暖，但家里的暖气炉却一直开着，这表明斯蒂芬烧毁了证据。

sentences.en: The security system showed there were no trips of the front door, garage service door or egress window after Stephen Orwine left the house to go pick up Joe,
sentences.zh: 安保系统显示，在斯蒂芬·奥尔温离开家去接乔之后，前门、车库服务门或逃生窗均未被触发，

sentences.en: meaning nobody entered the residence through those three entry points.
sentences.zh: 这意味着没有人通过这三个入口进入过住宅。

sentences.en: The prosecution's case ended with a detailed timeline of the improbable coincidences between the actions of Dog Day Guard and the actions of Stephen Orwine.
sentences.zh: 检方的结案陈词详细列出了“Dog Day Guard”的行为与斯蒂芬·奥尔温的行为之间那些不可思议的巧合。

sentences.en: It was impossible not to draw the conclusion that both were one and the same.
sentences.zh: 人们很难不得出结论：两者就是同一个人。

sentences.en: Orwine's defence lawyer did his best with what he had.
sentences.zh: 奥尔温的辩护律师已尽其所能利用手头的证据进行辩护。

sentences.en: There was a neighbour who may or may not have seen Amy around 5pm when the prosecution said she was dead.
sentences.zh: 有一位邻居可能在下午5点左右见过艾米，而检方称那时她已经遇害。

sentences.en: There were the reports from neighbours and the dog trainers using Amy's facility that two cars had roared away from the property at around 5.45 that evening.
sentences.zh: 还有邻居和使用艾米设施的训犬师报告称，当晚5点45分左右，有两辆车从该房产处疾驰而去。

sentences.en: There was the unlocked, unmonitored patio door that was never tested for prints and the dogs that were usually in the backyard to deter anyone from entering the house that way
sentences.zh: 此外还有一个未上锁、未受监控的露台门，从未进行过指纹检测，而通常在后院看家护院、防止外人进入的狗当时也不在场。

sentences.en: were locked in their kennels.
sentences.zh: 被关在各自的狗舍里。

sentences.en: The prosecution said
sentences.zh: 检方称，

sentences.en: Amy had been killed in the hallway and then moved to the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 艾米是在走廊里被杀害，随后被移到了卧室。

sentences.en: However, there was no blood on the carpet between the hallway and Amy nor had the carpet been cleaned and it's unlikely
sentences.zh: 然而，走廊到艾米所在位置之间的地毯上并没有血迹，地毯也没有被清洗过，而且不太可能

sentences.en: Stephen could have carried her.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬能搬动她。

sentences.en: With medical evidence ruling out suicide, the only alternative theory the defence could offer was that somebody else killed Amy that evening.
sentences.zh: 由于医学证据排除了自杀的可能性，辩方能提出的唯一替代理论是，那天晚上有其他人杀害了艾米。

sentences.en: The intruders would have entered via the patio door with the dogs safely locked in their kennels, killed as scopolamine dosed Amy while Stephen was establishing his alibi
sentences.zh: 入侵者会从露台门进入，此时狗被安全地关在狗舍里，在斯蒂芬制造不在场证明的同时，杀害了被注射了东莨菪碱的艾米，

sentences.en: and then roared off in their separate vehicles.
sentences.zh: 然后分别驾车逃离。

sentences.en: However, with overwhelming computer forensic evidence that fingered Stephen as dog-day guard, all this theory did was suggest
sentences.zh: 然而，压倒性的计算机取证证据直指斯蒂芬就是那个“狗日”的守卫，这一理论反而暗示了

sentences.en: Stephen had finally been successful in finding his hitman.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬最终成功找到了他的职业杀手。

sentences.en: Either way, it took the jury just eight hours to declare Stephen guilty of premeditated murder.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，陪审团仅用了八个小时就裁定斯蒂芬蓄意谋杀罪名成立。

sentences.en: Given that Stephen had gunshot residue on his right hand, they determined that having failed to hire a hitman, he pulled the trigger himself.
sentences.zh: 鉴于斯蒂芬的右手上有枪击残留物，他们认定，在雇佣杀手失败后，他亲自扣动了扳机。

sentences.en: At the sentencing hearing,
sentences.zh: 在量刑听证会上，

sentences.en: Amy's family spoke of the hole left in their lives.
sentences.zh: 艾米的家人谈到了她离世后在他们生活中留下的巨大空洞。

sentences.en: Her parents had come to the trial with open hearts, hoping that Stephen would be proven innocent.
sentences.zh: 她的父母带着宽容的心来到庭审现场，希望斯蒂芬能被证明是无辜的。

sentences.en: They had provided
sentences.zh: 他们曾

sentences.en: Stephen with a home from the time of Amy's death until he was arrested, so they felt doubly betrayed when the evidence convinced them they had been housing not only an adulterer,
sentences.zh: 在艾米去世到斯蒂芬被捕期间为他提供住所，因此当证据让他们确信自己收留的不仅是一个通奸者，

sentences.en: but their daughter's murderer.
sentences.zh: 还是杀害他们女儿的凶手时，他们感到双重背叛。

sentences.en: For the first time,
sentences.zh: 这是第一次，

sentences.en: Stephen spoke.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬开口了。

sentences.en: In a rambling speech that went too long, he maintained his innocence and love for Amy.
sentences.zh: 在一场冗长且语无伦次的演讲中，他坚称自己是无辜的，并声称深爱着艾米。

sentences.en: He said he had been locked up with drug addicts, child molesters and kidnappers, but that he was bringing God to them.
sentences.zh: 他说自己被关在毒贩、恋童癖和绑架犯中间，但他正在引导他们皈依上帝。

sentences.en: Three atheists so far had been turned and were now attending
sentences.zh: 目前已经有三名无神论者被感化，现在正在定期参加

sentences.en: Bible studies regularly.
sentences.zh: 圣经学习班。

sentences.en: Judge Ekstrom was having none of it.
sentences.zh: 埃克斯特罗姆法官根本不吃这一套。

sentences.en: Addressing Stephen directly, he told him he believed he was a hypocrite and a great actor who could turn tears on and off.
sentences.zh: 他直接对斯蒂芬说，他认为他是个伪君子，是个能随时收放眼泪的伟大演员。

sentences.en: Stephen was sentenced to mandatory life in prison, without parole.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: The United Church of God put out a lengthy public release that expressed concern about the potential negative media coverage the case could bring the church, given the fact
sentences.zh: 上帝联合教会发布了一份冗长的公开声明，表达了对该案件可能给教会带来的潜在负面媒体报道的担忧，鉴于

sentences.en: that Mr. Ulwine was technically a lay minister at the time.
sentences.zh: 乌尔温先生当时在名义上是一名平信徒牧师。

sentences.en: It barely mentioned Amy.
sentences.zh: 声明中几乎没有提到艾米。
